_doc: MISUMI HFS5-2080: a 80 x 20 mm aluminium extrusion of its 5 series, clear anodised (HFSB5-2080 is the same section in black). Dimensions, area, second moments and mass are from MISUMI's catalogue page; it is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (bending across the 20 mm). The drawn outline leaves out the small V marks on the core. MISUMI prints no section modulus or torsion constant.
name: profile-2080-misumi-hfs5

family.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

series.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

cells_across.rule: 4 cells side by side: 4 slots in each wide face
cells_across.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

cells_up.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

corner_radius.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

slot.rule: Every face has the 5 series' slot
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

chamber_width.rule: The three closed hollows between the cells run out to a wall of 2 mm each side: the drawing prints a 2 beside one, read here as that wall (20 less 4), and 12 for each hollow along the section, which is two slot depths. Taken as an estimate, since the 2 has no extension lines
chamber_width.source: scaled off the section drawing on MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf (the drawing prints no figure for it)

bore_diameter.rule: Centre bore of each cell, "4-Ø4.2" on the drawing
bore_diameter.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

bore_thread.rule: End tapping (alteration LTP, RTP, TPW) cuts M5, 15 mm deep, in this bore
bore_thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-757, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_757.pdf

area.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

inertia_x.rule: Cross sectional moment of inertia 2.56 x 10^4 mm⁴ (the page's lx: the smaller, bending across the 20 mm)
inertia_x.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

inertia_y.rule: Cross sectional moment of inertia 36 x 10^4 mm⁴ (the page's ly: the larger, bending across the 80 mm)
inertia_y.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

mass_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

alloy.rule: Material of the HFS type, as the page's table gives it (the NFS type of the same section is A6063S-T5)
alloy.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

material.rule: The kit's rule set for A6N01SS-T5, from MISUMI's own mechanical properties table
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf

lengths.rule: Fixed length parts (KHFS5-2080): 4000 mm (4000 is the effective length)
lengths.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

cut_length_min.rule: Configurable length, from 50 mm in 0.5 mm steps
cut_length_min.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

cut_length_max.rule: Configurable length, to 4000 mm (6000 for some, by special order)
cut_length_max.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-531, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_531.pdf

cut_tolerance.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-527, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_527.pdf

straightness_per_metre.rule: Bend: 0.3 mm or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 38 mm (this section's is 82.5 mm), which is 1.00 mm in a metre. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
straightness_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf

twist_per_metre.rule: Twist: 1/4 degree or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 76 mm (82.5 mm here), at most 3 degrees over the whole length. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
twist_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf
